Home.hubQuickTitle: Popular tools to try right now
Home.aboutBody1: LifeHub brings together practical calculators and conversion tools across 7 categories — Life & Health, Finance & Investment, Image & Media, Documents & PDF, Fun & Entertainment, Dev & IT, and General Utilities — all in one free service. No sign-up or installation is required; just search for a tool or browse by category and start using it right away.
Home.aboutBody2: Most tools process your input entirely in your browser rather than sending it to a server. You can enter sensitive numbers like loan amounts or asset details without worrying about them leaving your device. See our Privacy Policy page for the full details.
Home.aboutBody3: LifeHub was built for anyone who wants to track everyday health metrics, plan a loan or retirement savings strategy, convert photo or document file formats, or reach for a quick encoding or decoding tool while coding — a genuinely wide range of everyday needs.
Home.aboutBody4: LifeHub currently offers over 200 tools in four languages — Korean, English, Japanese, and Spanish — and new tools are added regularly based on user feedback. If there's a tool you'd like to see, feel free to suggest it on our Contact page.
